mentions.name: TCL-Edit
mentions.description: A small Tcl/Tk text editor, cleaned up and released as the first item from the author's years-accumulated personal utility collection (stuff42.tar.gz). It is styled as a Tcl/Tk clone of the Rust clone of Microsoft Edit.
mentions.source_excerpt: The first thing I cleaned up was TCL-Edit <https://gitlab.com/siddfinch/tcl-editor>, a small Tcl/Tk text editor I wrote a long time ago. After seeing the Rust clone of Microsoft EDIT, I realized the obvious next step was to build a Tcl/Tk clone of the Rust clone of Microsoft Edit.
